g.title: JCPINN
g.text: JCPFLW range handling + JCPSIG locked ensemble

g.title: input
g.text: Called from B at p, or at a trial p + dp during radial return
Inputs: T, log10(fixed rate), density ρ, model G and current p_eval

g.title: flags
g.text: JCPFLW: start this evaluation with flag = 0
Set condition-range bits; keep T, rate, density and G inputs unchanged

g.title: flagdetail
g.text: Bit 2: T < 30 or T > 300 °C; or rate / ρ / G outside their ranges
Implementation allows tiny numeric tolerances for rate / ρ / G.
Flags identify range excursions; they do not establish validity.

g.title: lower
g.text: No strain-range flag from this lower extension

g.title: scale
g.text: JCPSIG: x = [T, log10(rate), ρ, G, e]
Standardise using the saved training mean and scale

g.title: upper
g.text: Constant flow-stress extension; set flag bit 1

g.title: each
g.text: For each of the five locked members k:
Each member has its own jointly trained Equation 1 constants

g.title: net
g.text: Compute δ_k with the saved 5 → 16 → 16 → 1 tanh MLP
Compute dδ_k/de and d ln(b_k)/de analytically
Accumulate log stress: ln(b_k) + δ_k, and its strain derivative

g.title: fail
g.text: ANSYS wrapper reports the material error → B / A

g.title: ensemble
g.text: This is the geometric mean of member stresses, not an arithmetic mean

g.title: derivative
g.text: Inside the interval, including its endpoints: H = H_raw
Return σy, H and this evaluation's flag bits to B

g.title: semantics
g.text: Training coordinate: total axial E11; USERMAT input: equivalent plastic strain.
That mapping is an explicit assumption, not a measured equivalence.
Weights and constants are embedded in Fortran: no Python call or retraining.
Selected training physics penalty λ = 0; the Equation 1 backbone remains.
Softening is not regularised: the bracket post-yield response is mesh dependent.
Test was not blind; units user-confirmed without generator documentation.
No experimental validation, no validation above 200 °C, no critical-flaw prediction.
